mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2020-2021 FEDFUNDS < 0.1% correlated with SPX 20d returns > 0
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.1% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% for three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2020 Q2 UNRATE > 5.5% preceded negative SPX 5d returns
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in UNRATE > 5.5% periods are positive in > 60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by >0.5% and GDP growth (GDPC1) increase by >0.5% over 3 months indicates supply chain disruption that raises input costs and reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2021 Q1 INDPRO drop and GDPC1 rise correlated with negative SPX 60d returns
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in INDPRO < -0.5% and GDPC1 > 0.5% periods are positive in > 60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1400 thousand units in late-cycle expansion signals robust consumer confidence and residential investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2021 Q1 HOUST > 1400 correlated with positive SPX 20d returns
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in HOUST > 1400 periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 144 million indicates strong labor market conditions that increase disposable income and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.

failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in PAYEMS > 144m periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL > 265 periods are positive in > 60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.

evidence_refs: fact:2021 Q1 FEDFUNDS > 0.1% in tightening cycle correlated with negative SPX 60d returns
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS > 0.1% tightening periods are positive in > 60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.
